demo-reel.mp4.title: Live Demo Reel
demo-reel.mp4.about: Every live demo recorded headless by Playwright on the real GPU, trimmed to 5 s, titled and crossfaded with one ffmpeg filter graph (63 clips).
demo-reel.mp4.prompt: Write a Playwright script that opens each demo page, records a few seconds of video, then use ffmpeg to trim each clip, burn in its title and chain xfade transitions into one MP4 reel.
